criterion: Starting on the launcher, select API Request Audit and verify that its dashboard or request explorer is displayed without an application error.
steps_taken: Opened the launcher and verified the API Request Audit card was visible.
Verified the dashboard, request explorer, request summary metrics, and data table displayed without an application error.

criterion: Starting on the API Request Audit page, use the browser Back control and verify that the launcher is displayed with the Dashboards card visible.
steps_taken: Opened the launcher and verified the Dashboards card was visible.
Selected API Request Audit and verified its page loaded.
Used browser Back and verified the launcher returned with the Dashboards card visible.

criterion: Starting on the launcher with the Dashboards card visible, select Dashboards and verify that the placeholder displays the "Under construction" message and a "Back to Launcher" control without an application error.
steps_taken: Opened the launcher and verified the Dashboards card was visible.
Verified the placeholder displayed "Under construction" and the "Back to Launcher" control without an application error.
